subject.title: [Bug]: A2A source reply repeats after successful message delivery

question: Should the A2A duplicate-delivery regression be prioritized as a narrow maintainer-owned repair now that a focused QA reproduction is available?
rationale: The issue is protected with the `maintainer` label, so repository policy requires explicit maintainer handling even though the report identifies a plausible bounded fix.

options.title: Prioritize narrow repair
options.body: Confirm the reported current-source marker contract and land a focused classifier plus regression test.

options.title: Request source-path confirmation
options.body: Ask for a current-main trace of the classifier and QA fixture before assigning the repair owner.

recommendation.title: Prioritize narrow repair
recommendation.body: Confirm the reported current-source marker contract and land a focused classifier plus regression test.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the concrete reproduction and diagnosis and are the best available follow-up contact from the provided evidence.
